0022600210.text: The Golden State Warriors (7-3, with a seven-game winning streak, a 5-1 home record, and a 2nd-place finish in the Pacific, 1.5 games back) host the New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, on a two-game losing streak, 1-3 on the road, and 11th in the West) in the Warriors' 11th game of the season. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), while Gary Payton II and Gui Santos are day-to-day with knee issues and are game-time decisions. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Zion Williamson (rest), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 113-109 loss to the Pelicans in New Orleans on February 24.
